title: An Adaptive Multi-Parameter ADMM Algorithm for Embedded MPC
summary: We introduce an adaptive multi-parameter variant of ADMM and prove that it exhibits local superlinear convergence once the set of active constraints has been identified. In simulations, the proposed algorithm consistently outperforms OSQP, a standard ADMM solver, in terms of iteration count. We then implement an MPC solver based on our method and compare its runtime against a broader selection of state-of-the-art algorithms.
